name: 032_attention_weights_matmul_with_value_projection
description: Fused attention weights @ value matmul with transpose and reshape. Performs attn_weights @ value_states followed by transpose from (batch, num_heads, seq_len, head_dim) to (batch, seq_len, num_heads, head_dim) and reshape to (batch, seq_len, hidden_size). This is the second major matmul in attention that combines attention weights with value states, appearing 64 times per forward pass.
axes: {"batch_size": {"type": "var", "description": "Batch size"}, "seq_len": {"type": "var", "description": "Sequence length"}, "num_attention_heads": {"type": "const", "value": 40, "description": "Number of attention heads"}, "head_dim": {"type": "const", "value": 128, "description": "Head dimension"}, "hidden_size": {"type": "const", "value": 5120, "description": "Hidden size (num_attention_heads * head_dim)"}}
inputs: {"attn_weights": {"shape": ["batch_size", "num_attention_heads", "seq_len", "seq_len"], "dtype": "bfloat16", "description": "Attention weights after softmax"}, "value_states": {"shape": ["batch_size", "num_attention_heads", "seq_len", "head_dim"], "dtype": "bfloat16", "description": "Value states after GQA expansion"}}

reference:
import torch

@torch.no_grad()
def run(
    attn_weights: torch.Tensor,
    value_states: torch.Tensor,
) -> torch.Tensor:
    """
    Fused attention weights @ value matmul with transpose and reshape.
    
    Args:
        attn_weights: Attention weights after softmax, shape (batch, 40, seq_len, seq_len)
        value_states: Value states after GQA expansion, shape (batch, 40, seq_len, 128)
        
    Returns:
        Reshaped attention output ready for output projection, shape (batch, seq_len, 5120)
    """
    # Constants
    num_attention_heads = 40
    head_dim = 128
    hidden_size = 5120
    
    # Step 1: Attention weights @ value states
    # (batch, 40, seq_len, seq_len) @ (batch, 40, seq_len, 128) -> (batch, 40, seq_len, 128)
    attn_output = torch.matmul(attn_weights, value_states)
    
    # Step 2: Transpose to move heads dimension
    # (batch, 40, seq_len, 128) -> (batch, seq_len, 40, 128)
    attn_output = attn_output.transpose(1, 2)
    
    # Step 3: Reshape to combine heads
    # (batch, seq_len, 40, 128) -> (batch, seq_len, 5120)
    batch_size, seq_len = attn_output.shape[0], attn_output.shape[1]
    attn_output = attn_output.reshape(batch_size, seq_len, hidden_size)
    
    # Ensure contiguous for next operation
    attn_output = attn_output.contiguous()
    
    return attn_output
